AI PANEL · WITHHELD
Veyro is not offering a revenue interpretation while the underlying figures are stale. It will return when the pipeline catches up.
Per-panel provenance, not a page-level spinner.
Stale numbers de-emphasise to secondary and carry a timestamp; live ones stay primary. The AI panel withholds itself rather than reasoning from old data — an interpretation built on stale inputs is the one thing worse than no interpretation.
COMPONENTS · empty-success state · Banner(page, attention) · MetricCell(stale variant — see change log DS-CL-01) · AITreatment(withheld state)
RESPONSIVE · LOADING · INTERACTION
Behaviour engineering needs
bp.xl · 1600+
Content caps at 1440 and centres. The AI panel and the two chart cards sit in a right column at 480 rather than the attention queue stretching — a 1,600px-wide exception row is harder to read, not easier.
bp.lg · 1200–1599 · TARGET
As drawn. Rail expanded at 184, metrics in four columns, AI panel and charts share a row below the queue. This is the layout to build first.
bp.md · 900–1199
Rail collapses to 56px icons with labels on hover and focus. Metrics go 2×2. AI panel and charts stack full-width.
The attention queue never collapses
— it is the reason the page exists.
bp.sm AND BELOW
Rail becomes a sheet from a menu button. Metrics scroll horizontally as a single row of cards — the one place horizontal scroll is right, because they are peers with no comparison axis. Attention rows stack their actions and the primary goes full-width. Charts drop to a sparkline plus the stated conclusion in words, since a 12-bar comparison at 360px is decoration.
LOADING · FOUR INDEPENDENT REQUESTS
Shell and rail render immediately from cached role and scope. Then, in parallel and each with its own skeleton at true final height: metrics, attention queue, charts, AI panel.
No spinners anywhere.
The queue arrives before the charts by priority. If the AI panel is slowest it shows a skeleton, never a delay on anything else.
INTERACTION · KEY BEHAVIOURS
Queue is one tab stop;
↑↓
moves rows,
⏎
runs the primary action,
S
snoozes. Resolving collapses the row in place with a 30-second undo toast; the open count decrements visibly. New items arrive as a “3 new” pill at the top and never inject into a list being read. Scope change re-fetches everything and states the new scope in the heading, not only the chrome.

STATES · ADM-CC-06
Unassigned
as drawn.
Assigned to me
shows the owner and adds Release.
Assigned to someone else
keeps every action visible but read-only, with "Nadia is handling this" and a Take over that records the handover.
Resolved

PERMISSIONS
A Club Manager sees only the two members at their club and a JOD total scoped to them. Reception can open the sheet but has no batch action — only Take payment per member. An exception a role cannot act on never enters their queue in the first place.
KEYBOARD
Opens with focus on the heading, not the primary action — a destructive default under a returning Enter key is how batch messages get sent by accident.
Esc

WHY THE LOGGER IS DARK
Follows system, and free-weight areas are dim — but the deeper reason is that a phone held between sets at arm's length in a mirror-lined room is a glare problem. The logger was validated in both themes per the Foundations decision; this is the one that gets used.
THE ACTIVE SET IS THE ONLY TAP TARGET
Completed sets are records, not controls — they read at 16px and are editable only by long-press. The current set gets 20px numerals, a 44px Log button and the accent wash. One thumb, no aiming. Weight and reps step by ±2.5kg and ±1 on swipe rather than opening a keyboard.
OFFLINE IS THE DEFAULT ASSUMPTION
Gyms have basements and thick walls. Every set, note and voice memo writes locally first and syncs opportunistically — there is no “saving” state and no error if the network is gone, because a coach cannot stop a session to deal with connectivity. The only visible sync signal is a quiet line at the bottom, and it says what is queued rather than what failed.
SESSION COMPLETION IS ONE TAP
End → the session is verified, the credit decrements, the member's app updates, and the note is attached. No separate verification screen, which is precisely why 31 sessions accumulated unverified in the old flow: verification was a second visit to a different place.

THE 30–60 SECOND CLAIM, ACCOUNTED FOR

2 taps.

Total around 35 seconds for a plan that respects his allergy, his dislike of fish, his training days and his current cut. The target is met by not asking, not by making the form faster.
LOCAL FOOD IS NOT A GARNISH
Mansaf, kofta, flatbread, dates. A nutrition product for Amman that proposes quinoa bowls gets ignored in week one — the food has to be what people actually eat, with the macros computed against local preparations rather than a US database.
THE CLINICAL GATE, UNCHANGED
This plan auto-assigns because Ahmad has no flagged condition. Had he one, the same screen would show
“needs review by a qualified professional”
in place of the Assign button, with the plan preserved and routed. Veyro defines no clinical criteria — the routing point is built, the rules arrive from whoever holds clinical accountability in each market, and
the UX does not change when they do.
AI IS MARKED, EVIDENCED, AND STOPS SHORT
The indigo panel is
color.semantic.ai
— system-owned, so a white-label tenant cannot make generated content look like the club's own prescription. “See the numbers” opens the derivation. Nothing is assigned without the coach's tap.

When Veyro staff need to see a customer's data
START AN IMPERSONATION SESSION · TIER 4
Access Nadi Group as an administrator
You will see their real member data, including names, phone numbers, payment records and health notes.
Nadi Group is notified immediately
and this session appears in an audit log they can read.
WHY · REQUIRED, AND THEY WILL READ IT
Support ticket #4182 — Rania reports the Khalda class roster showing the wrong coach…
|
FOR HOW LONG
30 min
2 hours
ACCESS LEVEL
Read only
Can act
Read-only is the default and covers most support work.
"Can act" requires a second Veyro approver and is limited to 30 minutes regardless of what is selected above.
Start read-only session
Cancel
DURING THE SESSION · PERSISTENT BAR
Viewing Nadi Group · read only
21 minutes left · ticket #4182
End now
The bar cannot be dismissed or scrolled away, on any screen, for the whole session. Every page view is logged with its screen ID. When the timer expires the session ends mid-action — unsaved work is discarded rather than the clock extended.
WHAT REMAINS HIDDEN EVEN HERE
Biometric templates, stored card numbers and clinical nutrition notes are not visible in any impersonation session at any level. They are not rendered and not fetched. A support engineer debugging a roster does not need a member's medical history, and the architecture should make that impossible rather than merely discouraged.
